title: The Scholarship of the water tower
author: Juniper Blackwood
blurb: Noor Nakamura, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
